### 1. Architecture Overview
- **Type definition**: `pkg/apis/datasource/v0alpha1/connection.go` defines the API type `DataSourceConnection` (title, name, group, version, plugin) and its list/query companions. It is the contract for the datasource “connections” API served by Grafana.
- **Producer**: The datasource service implements `DataSourceConnectionProvider.ListConnections`, converting persisted datasource records into `DataSourceConnection` instances (`pkg/services/datasources/service/datasource.go`).
- **Consumer (server-side API client)**: `pkg/api/datasource/connections.go` is a client that calls the Kubernetes-style endpoint `/apis/datasource.grafana.app/v0alpha1/.../connections` and unmarshals the JSON payload into `DataSourceConnectionList`.
- **Tests/mocks**: Unit tests construct `DataSourceConnection`/`DataSourceConnectionList` directly (e.g., `connections_test.go`, `sub_query_test.go`) to validate behavior and satisfy interfaces.

Adding a new required field `AuthConfig AuthenticationConfig` to `DataSourceConnection` touches the definition, the producer that builds instances, and every test/mock/consumer that constructs or unmarshals the struct.

### 2. Detailed Analysis (evidence-backed)
- **DataSourceConnection definition (breaking contract)**  
  - Fields today: `Title`, `Name`, `APIGroup`, `APIVersion`, `Plugin` (`pkg/apis/datasource/v0alpha1/connection.go`, lines 35-50). Adding `AuthConfig AuthenticationConfig` here changes the API schema and JSON contract for all producers/consumers.
  - Interfaces in the same file (`DataSourceConnectionProvider`, `DataSourceConnectionQuery`, `DataSourceConnectionList`) rely on this struct as the payload shape.

- **Producer of the struct**  
  - `ListConnections` builds a `DataSourceConnectionList` and fills each `DataSourceConnection` via `asConnection` (`pkg/services/datasources/service/datasource.go`, lines 220-305).  
    - `asConnection` currently sets only `Title`, `APIGroup`, `APIVersion`, `Name`, `Plugin` (lines 297-304). When `AuthConfig` becomes required, this constructor must be extended to populate it (likely derived from datasource auth settings).

- **Consumer / API client**  
  - `GetConnectionByUID` unmarshals server responses into `dsV0.DataSourceConnectionList` (`pkg/api/datasource/connections.go`, lines 51-80). The JSON decoder will expect/provide the new field; downstream code/tests that assert on fields must account for it.

- **Tests and mocks constructing the type (will fail or need updates)**  
  - `connections_test.go` builds `DataSourceConnectionList{Items: []DataSourceConnection{{Name: "conn1"}, ...}}` (lines 80-93). New required field must be set or tests adapted.  
  - `sub_query_test.go` mock provider methods return `*v0alpha1.DataSourceConnection` / `*v0alpha1.DataSourceConnectionList` (lines 104-111); signatures stay but any concrete construction must include the new field.

- **Registry layer (interfaces)**  
  - `PluginDatasourceProvider` (in `pkg/registry/apis/datasource/plugincontext.go`, lines 20-39) exposes `GetConnection/ListConnections` via implementations; while not constructing the struct directly, any implementation returning concrete `DataSourceConnection` must populate the new field.

### 3. Relevant Files
| Repo | File Path | Why |
|------|-----------|-----|
| grafana | pkg/apis/datasource/v0alpha1/connection.go | Defines `DataSourceConnection` struct and API types; adding `AuthConfig` changes the contract (lines 35-50). |
| grafana | pkg/services/datasources/service/datasource.go | Producer of `DataSourceConnection` via `ListConnections`/`asConnection`; must set new `AuthConfig` (lines 220-305). |
| grafana | pkg/api/datasource/connections.go | Client unmarshalling `DataSourceConnectionList`; schema change affects JSON decoding (lines 51-80). |
| grafana | pkg/api/datasource/connections_test.go | Tests constructing `DataSourceConnectionList` items; need to include new required field (lines 80-93). |
| grafana | pkg/registry/apis/datasource/sub_query_test.go | Mock provider returns `*DataSourceConnection`/`*DataSourceConnectionList`; constructions must reflect new field (lines 104-111). |
| grafana | pkg/registry/apis/datasource/plugincontext.go | Interface `PluginDatasourceProvider` exposes connection methods; any implementations returning `DataSourceConnection` must supply `AuthConfig` (lines 20-39). |
| grafana | pkg/registry/apis/datasource/connections.go | REST storage for connections; returns provider results—expects `DataSourceConnection` shape from providers. |

These are all locations in the available repositories that define, construct, or consume `DataSourceConnection` and will be impacted by adding a required `AuthConfig AuthenticationConfig` field.

SUMMARY: Adding a required AuthConfig AuthenticationConfig field to the DataSourceConnection struct will break the API schema and all code that constructs or unmarshals it. The struct definition, the producer that builds instances, and all tests and mocks must be updated to populate the new field. Consumers and registry interfaces will also be affected by the schema change.

FILES:
- grafana/pkg/apis/datasource/v0alpha1/connection.go — Defines DataSourceConnection struct; adding AuthConfig changes the API contract
- grafana/pkg/services/datasources/service/datasource.go — Producer that builds DataSourceConnection instances; must populate AuthConfig
- grafana/pkg/api/datasource/connections.go — Client that unmarshals DataSourceConnectionList; schema change affects JSON decoding
- grafana/pkg/api/datasource/connections_test.go — Tests constructing DataSourceConnectionList; must include new required field
- grafana/pkg/registry/apis/datasource/sub_query_test.go — Mock provider returning DataSourceConnection/DataSourceConnectionList; constructions must include AuthConfig
- grafana/pkg/registry/apis/datasource/plugincontext.go — Interface exposing connection methods; implementations must supply AuthConfig
- grafana/pkg/registry/apis/datasource/connections.go — REST storage returning provider results; expects updated DataSourceConnection shape
